primary_data_model: Published H0DN baseline, original cosmography q0=-0.55,j0=1 and published covariance. BG1 independent conditional on frozen background model. No local observed fit.
alternative: log10 Hlocal - log10 Hbackground = log10 K, with beta=ALPHA_FINE_CODATA_2018*sqrt(e), law and inputs from frozen Fase9
nuisance: Every original H0DN parameter other than h=log10H is nuisance. Second model appends cCep with no prior. cCep is 1 only in Cepheid host-distance equations, 0 in calibration/flow/group/maser equations.
support: Eigendecompose symmetric C. Admit positive eigenvalues above 64*eps*n*maxeig only if separated spectrum. Refuse substantive negative eigenvalues. Check both design and cCep lie in C support. No ridge regularization or covariance diagonalization. Synthetic vectors must lie in common support.
stress_status: Sensitivity coordinates, not measured priors, not additional TGL parameters. Added only as explicitly missing-mode scenarios, not claimed to be independent of published budgets.
stress_inference: Keep original influence weights. For extra tau noise, calculate true variance w C w + tau^2 (w c)^2; report both unadjusted false-positive rate and conservatively recalibrated power, without refitting weights. This is misspecification sensitivity, not a reoptimized C+tau^2 ccT fit.
exact_background_diagnostic: Using the same Gaussian physical BG draws, replace linear grad_h*dtheta by log10(H0+dH0)-log10(H0). Compare null size and power with primary, and retain linear Z in importance density weights. Do not modify threshold after seeing this diagnostic.
background: Gaussian log-coordinate approximation primary; preserve full BG1 covariance and audit exact log transformation separately. Propagate gradient(logH+logK) for TGL compatibility separately from null gradient(logH).
blinding: Generator agent retains class labels and seed. Estimator code, matrices and design frozen before generation. Masked data evaluated with frozen code, score hashes committed before labels are released. No claim that public historical H0 estimates were unknown.
